pack_name: 大洋医疗外贸英语 · 随身练习

items.en: patient lift
items.zh: 患者移位机
items.example: Which patient lift model are you interested in?
items.example_zh: 您对哪款患者移位机感兴趣？

items.en: sling
items.zh: 移位机吊带
items.example: The sling must be compatible with the lift.
items.example_zh: 吊带必须与移位机兼容。

items.en: safe working load / SWL
items.zh: 安全工作载荷
items.example: Please confirm the safe working load of the complete system.
items.example_zh: 请确认整套系统的安全工作载荷。

items.en: walker
items.zh: 助行架
items.example: Would you like to compare the available walker models?
items.example_zh: 您想比较一下可选的助行架型号吗？

items.en: rollator
items.zh: 带轮助行器
items.example: Does your customer need a rollator with a seat?
items.example_zh: 您的客户是否需要带座板的带轮助行器？

items.en: height-adjustable
items.zh: 高度可调的
items.example: Please confirm the adjustment range for this height-adjustable walker.
items.example_zh: 请确认这款高度可调助行架的调节范围。

items.en: power wheelchair
items.zh: 电动轮椅
items.example: Which power wheelchair configuration suits your market?
items.example_zh: 哪种电动轮椅配置适合您的市场？

items.en: joystick controller
items.zh: 摇杆控制器
items.example: Let me show you the documented joystick controls.
items.example_zh: 我来向您介绍文件规定的摇杆控制功能。

items.en: driving range
items.zh: 行驶续航距离
items.example: The driving range should be quoted with its test conditions.
items.example_zh: 介绍续航距离时应同时说明测试条件。

items.en: manual wheelchair
items.zh: 手动轮椅
items.example: Please confirm the seat width for the manual wheelchair order.
items.example_zh: 请确认这批手动轮椅订单的座宽。

items.en: handrim
items.zh: 手轮圈
items.example: The handrim is the ring used to propel the rear wheel.
items.example_zh: 手轮圈是用于推动后轮的轮圈。

items.en: seat width
items.zh: 座宽
items.example: What seat width do your customers require?
items.example_zh: 您的客户需要多大的座宽？

items.en: home care bed
items.zh: 居家护理床
items.example: What functions are required for the home care bed?
items.example_zh: 这款居家护理床需要哪些功能？

items.en: backrest adjustment
items.zh: 背部调节
items.example: Please demonstrate the supported backrest adjustment.
items.example_zh: 请演示实际支持的背部调节功能。

items.en: side rail
items.zh: 床护栏
items.example: Please confirm the side rail specification before ordering.
items.example_zh: 下单前请确认床护栏规格。

items.en: hospital bed
items.zh: 病床
items.example: Could you share the required hospital bed configuration?
items.example_zh: 能否告知所需的病床配置？

items.en: central braking system
items.zh: 中控制动系统
items.example: Is a central braking system included in this configuration?
items.example_zh: 这一配置是否包含中控制动系统？

items.en: IV pole
items.zh: 输液架
items.example: Please list the IV pole separately if it is optional.
items.example_zh: 如果输液架为选配，请单独列明。

items.en: axillary crutches
items.zh: 腋拐
items.example: Please confirm the size range for the axillary crutches.
items.example_zh: 请确认腋拐的尺寸范围。

items.en: forearm crutches
items.zh: 肘拐
items.example: Do you need forearm crutches or walking canes?
items.example_zh: 您需要肘拐还是手杖？

items.en: walking cane
items.zh: 手杖
items.example: Which walking cane design does your customer prefer?
items.example_zh: 您的客户更喜欢哪种手杖设计？

items.en: actuator
items.zh: 电动推杆
items.example: Please confirm the actuator model and installation requirements.
items.example_zh: 请确认电动推杆型号及安装要求。

items.en: spreader bar
items.zh: 移位机吊架
items.example: Please verify the sling and spreader bar combination.
items.example_zh: 请核实吊带与吊架的组合。

items.en: removable battery
items.zh: 可拆卸电池
items.example: Does this configuration include a removable battery?
items.example_zh: 这一配置是否包含可拆卸电池？

items.en: folding frame
items.zh: 折叠车架
items.example: Could you confirm the folded dimensions of the folding frame?
items.example_zh: 能否确认折叠车架折叠后的尺寸？

items.en: net weight
items.zh: 净重
items.example: Please state the net weight separately from the gross weight.
items.example_zh: 请将净重与毛重分别列出。

items.en: gross weight
items.zh: 毛重
items.example: We need the packed gross weight for the shipping estimate.
items.example_zh: 估算运费需要包装后的毛重。

items.en: dimensions
items.zh: 尺寸
items.example: Please provide the overall and packed dimensions.
items.example_zh: 请提供整机尺寸和包装尺寸。

items.en: battery capacity
items.zh: 电池容量
items.example: Please quote the battery capacity together with the nominal voltage.
items.example_zh: 请同时提供电池容量和标称电压。

items.en: OEM
items.zh: 原始设备制造；常见于贴牌生产
items.example: We can discuss your OEM requirements before confirming feasibility.
items.example_zh: 确认可行性前，我们可以讨论您的贴牌生产要求。

items.en: ODM
items.zh: 原始设计制造
items.example: Please describe the ODM scope you want us to evaluate.
items.example_zh: 请说明您希望我们评估的原始设计制造范围。

items.en: minimum order quantity / MOQ
items.zh: 最低订购量
items.example: What is the MOQ for the selected configuration?
items.example_zh: 所选配置的最低订购量是多少？

items.en: warranty
items.zh: 保修
items.example: What does the warranty cover, and when does it start?
items.example_zh: 保修涵盖哪些内容，从何时起算？

items.en: deposit
items.zh: 定金；预付款，具体含义按合同确认
items.example: Please confirm when the deposit is due under the agreed terms.
items.example_zh: 请确认约定条款下预付款的到期时间。

items.en: balance
items.zh: 尾款；剩余应付款
items.example: The balance is payable according to the agreed payment terms.
items.example_zh: 尾款按双方约定的付款条件支付。

items.en: quotation
items.zh: 报价单；报价
items.example: Please check the configuration and included items in the quotation.
items.example_zh: 请核对报价中的配置和包含项目。

items.en: CE marking
items.zh: CE标志；是否可使用须核对对应符合性资料
items.example: We will verify the CE documentation for the selected configuration.
items.example_zh: 我们会核实所选配置对应的CE文件。

items.zh: 医疗器械质量管理体系标准，不等同于某型号的产品批准
items.example: Please check the certificate scope before describing the quality system.
items.example_zh: 介绍质量体系前，请核对证书范围。

items.en: production lead time
items.zh: 生产周期，须说明起算条件
items.example: What is the production lead time for the patient lift order?
items.example_zh: 这批移位机订单的生产周期是多久？

items.en: production schedule
items.zh: 生产计划；生产排期
items.example: Please send the revised hospital bed production schedule.
items.example_zh: 请发送调整后的病床生产排期。

items.en: bill of materials / BOM
items.zh: 物料清单
items.example: Please use the approved BOM for this configuration.
items.example_zh: 请使用这一配置已批准的物料清单。

items.en: work in progress / WIP
items.zh: 在制品；在制工作
items.example: Please report WIP quantities by production stage.
items.example_zh: 请按生产阶段报告在制数量。

items.en: backorder
items.zh: 已接受但尚待补供的订单或数量
items.example: Please confirm the expected delivery date for the footrest backorder.
items.example_zh: 请确认待补供脚托的预计交付日期。

items.en: production batch
items.zh: 生产批次
items.example: Please identify the production batch in the progress report.
items.example_zh: 请在进度报告中注明生产批次。

items.en: partial shipment
items.zh: 部分装运；分批装运
items.example: We can review a partial shipment subject to written approval.
items.example_zh: 经书面批准后，我们可以评估分批装运。

items.en: cargo ready date / CRD
items.zh: 货物备妥日期，须约定备妥条件
items.example: Could you confirm the cargo ready date and release status?
items.example_zh: 能否确认货妥日期和放行状态？

items.en: Please confirm whether the deadline refers to dispatch or arrival.
items.zh: 请确认截止日期是指发货还是抵达。

items.en: The schedule starts after the deposit and specifications are confirmed.
items.zh: 在预付款到账、规格确认后开始计算排期。

items.en: The actuator delivery is later than the supplier confirmed.
items.zh: 电动推杆的交付晚于供应商确认的时间。

items.en: We are reviewing the remaining work before confirming a revised schedule.
items.zh: 确认调整后排期之前，我们正在评估剩余工作。

items.en: Could you prioritize the components for our trial order?
items.zh: 能否优先安排我们试单所需的零部件？

items.en: The expedited batch still needs the required inspections and release approval.
items.zh: 加急批次仍需完成规定检验和放行批准。

items.en: Please show the completed quantity at each production stage.
items.zh: 请列出各生产阶段已完成的数量。

items.en: I will provide the next production update by [date, time, time zone].
items.zh: 我会在[日期、时间及时区]前提供下一次生产进度更新。

items.en: QC inspection
items.zh: 质量检验
items.example: Please confirm the QC inspection scope and acceptance criteria.
items.example_zh: 请确认质量检验范围与验收准则。

items.en: dimensional tolerance
items.zh: 尺寸公差
items.example: Check the mounting dimensions against the approved tolerances.
items.example_zh: 请按已批准的公差核查安装尺寸。

items.en: root cause analysis
items.zh: 根本原因分析
items.example: The root cause analysis is still in progress.
items.example_zh: 根本原因分析仍在进行中。

items.en: corrective action
items.zh: 纠正措施，针对原因以防再次发生
items.example: Please explain how the corrective action addresses the confirmed cause.
items.example_zh: 请说明纠正措施如何针对已确认的原因。

items.en: torque specification
items.zh: 扭矩规范；规定扭矩要求
items.example: Please follow the controlled torque specification and record the results.
items.example_zh: 请遵照受控扭矩规范，并记录结果。

items.en: verification
items.zh: 验证；核实是否符合规定要求
items.example: Please identify the completed verification activities and remaining work.
items.example_zh: 请列明已完成的验证活动和剩余工作。

items.en: validation
items.zh: 确认；核实是否满足特定预期用途或应用
items.example: A fit check alone does not complete design validation.
items.example_zh: 单次试装检查不能代表完成设计确认。

items.en: certificate of compliance / certificate of conformity / CoC
items.zh: 符合性证明；须核实具体名称、签发方和范围
items.example: Do you need a shipment CoC, an EU DoC, or a specific test report?
items.example_zh: 您需要出货符合性证明、欧盟符合性声明，还是某项测试报告？

items.en: Please send the affected serial numbers, batch details, and clear photographs.
items.zh: 请发送受影响产品的序列号、批次信息及清晰照片。

items.en: Let us agree the sampling plan and acceptance criteria before booking inspection.
items.zh: 预约检验之前，我们先约定抽样方案与验收准则。

items.en: The inspection is complete; release authorization is still pending.
items.zh: 检验已完成；放行授权仍在等待中。

items.en: Please compare the proposed surface finish with the approved sample.
items.zh: 请将拟采用的表面效果与已批准样品进行比较。

items.en: Could we review the welding sequence to improve dimensional consistency?
items.zh: 能否评审焊接顺序，以改善尺寸一致性？

items.en: Please confirm the drawing number and revision before preparing samples.
items.zh: 制作样品之前，请确认图纸编号与版次。

items.en: Do not modify tooling or production settings before written change approval.
items.zh: 未经书面变更批准，不得修改工装或生产设定。

items.en: Sample approval does not automatically release the revised process for mass production.
items.zh: 样品获批不自动代表修订后的工艺已获准用于量产。

items.en: LiDAR / light detection and ranging
items.zh: 激光雷达；具体传感器配置以供货清单为准
items.example: LiDAR uses laser light to measure distance.
items.example_zh: 激光雷达利用激光光信号测距。

items.en: ultrasonic sensor
items.zh: 超声波传感器；不预设数量或覆盖范围
items.example: Ultrasonic sensors use sound waves for sensing.
items.example_zh: 超声波传感器利用声波进行感知。

items.en: automatic deceleration
items.zh: 自动减速
items.example: The DH01168 supports automatic slowing in response to detected obstacles.
items.example_zh: DH01168支持根据探测障碍作出自动减速响应。

items.en: automatic braking
items.zh: 自动刹车；触发条件按具体设计说明
items.example: Let us review the configuration-specific braking response.
items.example_zh: 我们一起了解这一配置对应的刹车响应。

items.en: app-based control
items.zh: 基于手机APP的控制；具体项目与权限须确认
items.example: The DH01168 supports app-based control.
items.example_zh: DH01168支持手机APP控制。

items.en: voice prompts / voice alerts
items.zh: 语音提示；不等于接受语音指令
items.example: Voice prompts provide spoken information to the user.
items.example_zh: 语音提示向用户提供语音信息。

items.en: battery management system / BMS
items.zh: 电池管理系统；DH01168具体支持项目待核实
items.example: We need to confirm the BMS functions for the selected battery.
items.example_zh: 需要核实所选电池的电池管理功能。

items.en: regenerative braking
items.zh: 再生制动；是否具备待核实，不承诺续航增益
items.example: Regenerative braking must be confirmed for the supplied configuration.
items.example_zh: 需确认实际供货配置是否支持再生制动。

items.en: The DH01168 combines obstacle-avoidance assistance, automatic slowing or braking, app control, and voice prompts.
items.zh: DH01168结合了避障辅助、自动减速或刹车、APP控制和语音提示功能。

items.en: Obstacle avoidance is an extra layer of assistance; users still need to follow the operating instructions.
items.zh: 避障增加了一层辅助；用户仍需遵循操作说明。

items.en: Tell us about your daily routes, and we can focus the demonstration on your needs.
items.zh: 请介绍您的日常路线，我们可以围绕您的需求安排演示。

items.en: For care facilities, we can explain the functions to purchasing teams and caregivers together.
items.zh: 面向养老护理机构，可以一起向采购团队和照护人员讲解功能。

items.en: For distributors, these confirmed functions provide a clear, easy-to-explain product story.
items.zh: 面向经销商，这些已确认功能构成清楚、容易讲解的产品介绍主线。

items.en: Voice prompts do not by themselves mean that spoken-command control is supported.
items.zh: 语音提示本身不代表支持语音指令控制。

items.en: App control does not by itself confirm remote monitoring or autonomous navigation.
items.zh: APP控制本身不代表支持远程监控或自主导航。

items.en: I will check the documented fault response and control priority before describing either function.
items.zh: 介绍故障响应或控制优先级之前，我会先核对文件规定。

items.en: Good morning. I'm [Name] from DAYANG MEDICAL in Guangdong, China.
items.zh: 早上好，我是来自中国广东大洋医疗的[姓名]。

items.en: Which product category and customer segment are you focusing on?
items.zh: 您重点关注哪类产品和哪类客户？

items.en: Could you share your target quantity and budget?
items.zh: 能否告知目标采购数量和预算？

items.en: Which items are included in the competing offer?
items.zh: 对方报价包含哪些项目？

items.en: Let me confirm the model, configuration, quantity, and delivery requirements.
items.zh: 我来确认一下型号、配置、数量和交付要求。

items.en: Which destination port should we quote for?
items.zh: 请问应按哪个目的港报价？

items.en: Please send your shipping instructions in writing.
items.zh: 请以书面形式发送装运指示。

items.en: Could you repeat the figure and confirm the currency?
items.zh: 能否重复这个数字，并确认币种？

items.en: Which time zone should we use for the follow-up call?
items.zh: 后续电话应按哪个时区安排？

items.en: I will summarize the agreed points and next steps in a follow-up email.
items.zh: 我会在跟进邮件中汇总已约定事项和下一步行动。

items.en: Hi. We're a US distributor looking for patient lifts. Could you introduce your product range?
items.zh: 您好，我们是寻找患者移位机的美国经销商。能否介绍一下您的产品范围？

items.en: Welcome to DAYANG MEDICAL. Our range includes patient lifts, wheelchairs, walking aids, care beds, hospital beds, and crutches.
items.zh: 欢迎来到大洋医疗。我们的产品包括移位机、轮椅、助行器、护理床、病床和拐杖。

items.en: Can you demonstrate the DY-L200 and explain what we should check for home care use?
items.zh: 能否演示DY-L200，并说明居家护理应用应核查哪些事项？

items.en: Certainly. I'll introduce the controls using a demonstration dummy. We should also confirm patient weight, bed clearance, doorway width, and sling compatibility.
items.zh: 当然。我会使用演示假人介绍控制方式，还需要确认患者体重、床下空间、门宽和吊带兼容性。

items.en: What are the safe working load and warranty terms in this practice case?
items.zh: 在本次练习设定中，安全工作载荷和保修条款是什么？

items.en: For this practice case, the safe working load is 180 kg. The frame and actuator are covered for 24 months from delivery; the battery is covered for 12 months.
items.zh: 【练习数据】安全工作载荷为180公斤。从交付日起，车架与推杆保修24个月，电池保修12个月。

items.en: Could you quote 20 units and tell us what is included?
items.zh: 能否按20台报价，并说明包含哪些项目？

items.en: For this practice quotation, 20 units are USD 460 each, FOB Shenzhen, including one compatible sling and charger. International freight, import duties, and taxes are extra.
items.zh: 【练习报价】20台单价为460美元，深圳港船上交货，每台包含一条兼容吊带和充电器；国际运费、进口关税和税费另计。

items.en: Please email the specifications and quotation. Can we also arrange a follow-up call?
items.zh: 请通过邮件发送规格和报价。还能安排一次后续电话吗？

items.en: I'll email the practice quotation and specifications tomorrow. Which time zone should we use for the follow-up call?
items.zh: 我明天会通过邮件发送这份练习报价及规格。后续电话应按哪个时区安排？

items.en: Your practice price of USD 460 is above another offer at USD 420. Can you do better?
items.zh: 您的练习报价为460美元，高于另一份420美元的报价。可以再优惠吗？

items.en: I understand your concern. Could we first compare the configurations, accessories, packaging, and warranty coverage to make sure both offers include the same items?
items.zh: 我理解您的顾虑。我们能否先比较配置、配件、包装和保修范围，确保两份报价包含相同项目？

items.en: We want only 20 units for a trial. What options can you review?
items.zh: 我们只想先试单20台。您可以评估哪些方案？

items.en: Let me review options for 20 units with standard packaging. Any revised price will need written confirmation before you place the order.
items.zh: 我来评估20台采用标准包装的方案。任何调整后的价格都需在下单前书面确认。

items.en: What lead time and payment terms should we use for this exercise?
items.zh: 本次练习应采用什么交期和付款条件？

items.en: For this exercise, allow 30 days after deposit receipt and specification approval. Payment is 30% upfront, with 70% before shipment.
items.zh: 【练习条件】预付款到账、规格批准后安排30天；付款为预付30%，发货前支付70%。

items.en: If we plan a later order of 50 units, could that support a volume discount?
items.zh: 如果我们计划之后订购50台，是否有助于获得数量优惠？

items.en: We can review a volume-based offer once you confirm the 50-unit plan. I'll check the approved discount options before quoting a revised price.
items.zh: 确认50台计划后，我们可以评估按数量制定的方案。提供调整后的报价前，我会核实获准的优惠选项。

items.en: Please clarify the quotation validity and shipping responsibilities before we decide.
items.zh: 在我们决定之前，请明确报价有效期和运输责任。

items.en: For this exercise, the quotation is valid for seven days. I'll confirm the Incoterm, included items, and freight responsibilities in writing.
items.zh: 【练习条件】报价有效期为7天。我会书面确认贸易术语、包含项目和运费责任。

items.en: In this practice case, we inspected 80 wheelchairs and found scratches on four frames. Can you help?
items.zh: 【练习情况】我们检查80台轮椅，发现4台车架有划痕。您能协助处理吗？

items.en: I'm sorry this has disrupted your work. Please send the affected serial numbers, batch details, quantities inspected, and clear photographs of the frames and packaging.
items.zh: 很遗憾这给您的工作带来影响。请提供受影响产品的序列号、批次、已检数量，以及车架和包装的清晰照片。

items.en: One of those four frames also has an irregular-looking weld. Is the weld defective?
items.zh: 这4台中有1台的焊缝外观也不规则。焊缝是否不合格？

items.en: We will record the weld concern separately and request a technical assessment. Photographs alone cannot establish the final conclusion.
items.zh: 我们会单独记录焊缝疑点，并申请技术评估。仅凭照片不能确定最终结论。

items.en: Can you promise an immediate free replacement for every affected wheelchair?
items.zh: 您能承诺立即免费更换每台受影响的轮椅吗？

items.en: We will assess the evidence and propose a remedy. Replacement, cost allocation, and any shipment changes need confirmation after technical and commercial review.
items.zh: 我们会评估证据并提出解决方案。更换、费用分担及出货调整需在技术与商务审核后确认。

items.en: Could we arrange an independent inspection before agreeing on the next step?
items.zh: 约定下一步之前，能否安排独立检验？

items.en: Yes. Let's agree the inspection scope, checklist, sample size, access arrangements, and fees before booking the inspection.
items.zh: 可以。预约检验之前，我们先约定检验范围、检查表、样本量、现场检查安排及费用。

items.en: When will you send the review plan, and can the affected units be released now?
items.zh: 您何时发送评审计划？受影响产品现在能否放行？

items.en: I'll send the proposed review plan by [date]. The affected units remain pending review; any disposition or shipment release requires documented assessment and authorization.
items.zh: 我会在[日期]前发送评审计划建议。受影响产品仍待评审；任何处置或出货放行都需要书面评估和授权。
